## Arch Capital's FY2024 10-K — Expected Impact of August 2024 PMIERs Update

Arch Capital reports that the August 21, 2024 PMIERs Guidance 2024-01 (issued by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac) incorporates **new deductions to the definition of "available assets"** for investment risk. The update takes effect **March 31, 2025**, with a phase-in through **September 30, 2026**.

Arch provides a **pro-forma sensitivity** in its FY2024 10-K (p. 90) showing what the impact would have been if fully implemented at year-end 2024:

| Metric | Reported (Dec 31, 2024) | Pro-forma (Fully Implemented) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Available Assets** | — | **Reduced by 17%** | −17% |
| **PMIERs Sufficiency Ratio** | **186%** | **154%** | −32 pp |

*Source: ACGL FY2024 10-K, Business / Regulation section (p. 90).*

### Key Context
- The actual reported PMIERs Sufficiency Ratio at December 31, 2024 was **186%** (down from **213%** at December 31, 2023).
- Under a full, immediate implementation of the August 2024 GSE update, that ratio would have fallen to **154%** — a decline of 32 percentage points driven entirely by the 17% reduction in available assets from the new investment-risk deductions.
- Because the update is phased in over the transition period (through September 2026), Arch's actual ratio will decline gradually rather than immediately, giving management time to adjust capital actions as needed.
rationale: Agent accurately identifies 17% available assets reduction and 154% pro-forma Sufficiency Ratio with March 31, 2025 effective date and phase-in through September 30, 2026.
